title: dep-scan vdb download output
description: The document `depscan vdb download --format json` writes on stdout after the download completed and the marker file was written: the image reference it downloaded and the marker file's path for a complete flavor, or the refreshed shard names and the marker file's path for --shards. A download that fails produces the error document instead of this one.

image.description: The image reference that was downloaded.

marker.description: The path of the marker file written for this download, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform. The file records the image reference; `depscan vdb info` reads it and reports that reference as its own marker field.

shards.description: The canonical shard names that were refreshed, in the order they were requested.

marker.description: The path of the marker file written for this refresh, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform. The file records the shard-set marker string; `depscan vdb info` reads it and reports that string as its own marker field.
